question: When a heavy nucleus ($A > 200$) splits into two intermediate nuclei, energy is released. Based on the Binding Energy per nucleon ($E_{bn}$) curve, what is the fundamental reason for this energy release?

options.A: The $E_{bn}$ of the fragments is lower than that of the parent nucleus.
options.B: The $E_{bn}$ of the fragments is higher than that of the parent nucleus.
options.C: The parent nucleus has no Coulomb repulsion.
options.D: The fragments lose mass to become neutrons.
